product_metadata.title: Big Boss 9338 Swirlio Frozen Fruit Dessert Maker, Black/Silver
features: Easy to clean and dishwasher safe parts
Make from 100% fruits and your favorite toppings
Great with bananas, pineapples, kiwis, berries, mangos, peaches, chocolate
description: No more throwing out the extra fruit! Freeze it and turn it into a healthy frozen dessert. The Big Boss Swirlio makes your favorite fruits into a soft serve frozen dessert in seconds! Peel, cut and freeze the fruits- insert them into the chute and voila, a delicious and healthy dessert is served! Use only with ingredients you consider best for you and your family.
